newsitem.title: USA: US stock index futures soar,June S&P hits new high.
newsitem.headline: US stock index futures soar,June S&P hits new high.

text.p: May 5 - U.S. stock index futures soared in late trading, with June S&P 500 futures at a fresh record high. June hit 835.00, wiping out the former record at 827.80 set February 19. Trading brisk, with gains sparked by Nasdaq strength. Traders said once T-bond futures closed, S&P 500 buyers emerged. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
